name: services/statements/statements
description: Get information of a multiple statements.
brief_description: Get information of a multiple statements.

arguments.name: fields
arguments.description: Selector of result fields you are interested in. The selector may contain any subset of fields, which are described in the returns section of statement method.

arguments.name: format
arguments.description: Format in which to return values. See supported output formats.

arguments.name: callback
arguments.description: Required only if you've chosen jsonp as a return format.

returns:
A dictionary: your statement_ids will be mapped to dictionary's keys, and each value will contain the description of one statement, as defined in the statement method.

For invalid statement_ids (statements which do not exist) null will be returned (instead of the statement object).
